tasks.subtask_prompt: You are a read-only auditor on the AK System monorepo. Run `pnpm -r run lint` from the repo root and capture the full output. Summarize: total errors, total warnings, and the top 5 most-occurring rule names with their counts. Do NOT fix anything — read-only audit.

You are a read-only auditor on the AK System monorepo. Run `pnpm --filter @ak-system/web build` from the repo root and capture the full output. Report: does the Next.js build succeed? List any TypeScript errors with file:line. Do NOT fix anything.

You are a read-only auditor on the AK System monorepo. Run `pnpm test` from the repo root and capture the full output. Report total suites/tests passed/failed/skipped, and the names of any failing tests. Do NOT fix anything.

You are a read-only auditor on the AK System monorepo. Compare packages/database/src/schema.ts (SQLite) and packages/database/src/schema.pg.ts (Postgres). For each table:
- Does it exist in both files?
- Do the columns match by name and (compatible) type?
- Are nullability and defaults consistent?

Report any table that exists in only one file, any column mismatch, and any constraint mismatch. Do NOT edit files — read-only audit.

You are a read-only auditor on the AK System monorepo. Inspect package.json files at the repo root and in apps/web, packages/api, packages/database, packages/types. Report:
- Top-level dependencies whose version pin uses `*` or `latest` (forbid these).
- Packages duplicated across workspaces with different versions.
- Any dependency marked deprecated in its npm entry (best-effort check; only flag well-known deprecated packages).

Do NOT edit any package.json — read-only audit.

You are a read-only auditor on the AK System monorepo. List every skill under .cursor/skills/ (every directory containing a SKILL.md). For each, report: name, one-line description (from the frontmatter), and whether SKILL.md exists with a valid YAML frontmatter.

You are the reviewer-agent for the AK System monorepo. The upstream tasks ran a six-part read-only audit (lint, build/typecheck, tests, schema drift, dependencies, skill inventory). Synthesize their outputs into a single report at reports/audit-smoke-audit-final.md.

Structure:
# Weekly Audit — smoke-audit-final

## Health snapshot
| Check | Status | Notes |
| Lint | OK / N warnings / N errors | top rules |
| Build / typecheck | OK / FAIL | first failure |
| Tests | OK / FAIL | failing tests |
| Schema drift | OK / N drifts | tables affected |
| Dependencies | OK / N issues | summary |
| Skills | N skills, all valid? | |

## Findings (sorted by severity)
## Recommendations (max 5, sorted by impact)
## Trend vs last audit (if reports/audit-*.md exists, mention regressions/improvements)

Do NOT edit production code or fix any of the findings — the audit is read-only. End by replying with the absolute path of the report.
